subcategory_text: The organization’s determination of risk tolerance is informed by its role(s) in the data processing ecosystem.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-15 (Security and Privacy Groups and Associations)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC-04 and ID.BE-P1 (role in data processing ecosystem)
implementation_examples: Factor the organisation's role(s) in the data processing ecosystem (controller, processor, joint controller) into the risk-tolerance statement
Document obligations that arise from the role (e.g., processor-only sub-processing review for processors, controller accountabilities for controllers)
Re-evaluate when the organisation's role changes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether role(s) in the data processing ecosystem are factored into risk tolerance
Determine whether role-driven obligations are documented
Determine whether risk tolerance accommodates shared-versus-single-party obligations
Determine whether role changes trigger a documented re-evaluation
